verdict.rationale: DeepSeek has a dedicated "Rate Limit & Isolation" page. It lists per-model concurrency limits (e.g. 2500/500 in the pricing tables), describes SSE keep-alive behavior under load, and points to an error-codes page that documents 429 semantics. Scaling is handled through a documented, free capacity-expansion request, and per-user isolation through `user_id`. Missing for 10: limits are stated as concurrency rather than requests/tokens per unit time; there is no published tier ladder, since scaling is case-by-case on request; and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the 429 behavior.
